HPX_SHORTCUTS.py.summary: This page class models the HP Shortcuts screen for Android mobile automation. It inherits from the SmartFlow base class and provides methods for interacting with the shortcuts screen, including navigation, editing, and confirmation flows. All methods use consistent parameter patterns with configurable timeouts and exception handling, and leverage Selenium-based driver utilities for robust UI automation.

methods.description: Verify the title of the Shortcuts screen.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time to wait for the shortcuts screen title element
Whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_purpose: Waits for the shortcuts screen title element to appear and verifies its presence, ensuring the UI is ready for further interaction.

methods.description: Click the Edit button on the Shortcuts screen.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time to wait for the edit button element
Whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_purpose: Waits for the edit button on the shortcuts screen to become available and performs a click action, enabling edit mode for shortcuts.

methods.description: Verify the Remove HP Access Confirmation message.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time to wait for the confirmation message element
Whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_purpose: Retrieves the text content of the remove HP access confirmation message element for validation and verification purposes.
